>     ADM3 BAS Cairo DIME DIRECT DPM.GGM ExactSampling FunCluster FunNet

>     binom brainwaver capme cghseg charlson cit coalescentMCMC colbycol
>     compositions compositionsGUI coxphw ecodist equivalence evdbayes
>     extracat fAssets fBonds fExtremes fPortfolio fRegression fTrading
>     factas flubase forensic ftnonpar gazetools gibbs.met huge
>     iSubpathwayMiner idbg ifa insideRODE integrOmics interactivity kknn
>     lawstat localdepth maxent mcgibbsit mcr mnormt mpa ndtv ndvits
>     pdfCluster phyloTop polyclip powell ppMeasures predmixcor proj4
>     qPCR.CT qlspack qtbase ref refund rgcvpack ringscale sampling seq2R
>     seqCBS sifds sisus snort spider survAUC tonymisc topologyGSA
>     validator waveslim weirs wle wombsoft yacca

> maintained by one of you, for which R CMD check finds problems in the
> 'whether package can be installed' check, see below for details.

> Can we pls have updates fixing these within the next 2 weeks?

> Note that other R CMD check problems may need to be addressed as well.

Still open for packages
